description: The collections of the corpus, the upstream sources they are built from and the works they are first published in.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for an editor.

sources.description: The upstream sources, by name. A source is a submodule under sources/ with that name; its repository URL and commit are read from git.

origins.description: The works that first published the pairs of a collection as inclusion questions, by citation key: the first author's last name and the year. An origin is a folder of the corpus, and it is not where a collection is fetched from, which is its source.

collections.description: The collections, by name, in the order they are built. A collection is one dataset of a source, and its name is its folder in the corpus, below the folder of its origin.

Name.description: The name of a source, of an origin or of a collection, which is the name of a folder.

Forge.description: Where the source is hosted, which decides how the permanent link to one of its files is written.

LabelOrigin.description: Where the answers come from. by-construction: the pair was built so that the answer is known. witness-generator: the upstream authors' complete but timeout-bound tool, so an unlabelled case means that it gave up. upstream-tests: the ground truth that the replication package of the jsonsubschema tool gives for its pairs.

UseCase.description: What the pairs of the collection are for.

OriginSpec.description: An origin: the work that first published the pairs of its collections as inclusion questions.

short.description: The work as a text names it in passing: the authors and the year, as in 'Habib et al., 2021', or what it is where it is no publication.

citation.description: The work, as a reference list gives it: authors, title, venue and year.

url.description: Where the work is found, as a permanent link where it has one.

SourceSpec.description: An upstream source: a submodule under sources/, at the commit it pins.

license.description: The SPDX identifier of the source's licence.

license_file.description: Where the text of the licence lives inside the source.

CollectionSpec.description: A collection: one dataset of a source, first published in the work of its origin.

origin.description: The citation key of the work that first published these pairs, one of those under origins. Its folder holds the folder of the collection.

source.description: The name of the source the collection is built from, one of those under sources.

path.description: Where the dataset lives inside the source.

description.description: What the collection holds, in one sentence that fits a row of a table.
